councils.name: Baltimore Area Council
councils.note: Home council for the National Pike District (Howard and SW Baltimore Counties). Wood Badge and NYLT run every spring and fall at Broad Creek.

councils.name: National Capital Area Council
councils.note: Covers DC, Prince George's, Montgomery and Frederick Counties plus Northern Virginia. NYLT runs winter and summer at Camp Snyder (Haymarket, VA).

councils.name: Del-Mar-Va Council
councils.note: Eastern Shore and Delaware. Wood Badge at Rodney Scout Reservation in North East, MD, with a low fee paid in installments.

councils.name: Shenandoah Area Council
councils.note: Absorbed the former Mason-Dixon Council (Hagerstown) in 2023; that area is now its Mason Dixon District. Camps: Rock Enon (VA) and Sinoquipe (PA).

councils.name: New Birth of Freedom Council
councils.note: York, Adams, Cumberland, Dauphin, Franklin and Perry Counties, PA. Posts BALOO and IOLS dates well into 2028.

councils.name: Pennsylvania Dutch Council
councils.note: Uses its own registration system (not scoutingevent.com). Has a Wood Badge Scholarship Fund. 2027 NYLT and Wood Badge dates not posted yet; call 717-394-4063.

councils.name: Chester County Council
councils.note: Very active merit badge calendar. Camp Horseshoe sits just over the line in Rising Sun, MD.

councils.name: Heart of Virginia Council
councils.note: NYLT runs in the fall (2026 was Sept). Next Wood Badge is Spring 2028. Offers Buckskin youth leadership and a University of Scouting.

councils.name: Cradle of Liberty Council
councils.note: Just past the two-hour line. Large Merit Badge College in Horsham, PA.

councils.name: Virginia Headwaters Council
councils.note: Beyond two hours, listed for its summer NYLT week at Camp Shenandoah.

councils.name: Scouting America (national)
councils.note: National-level courses open to Scouts and Scouters from any council.
